summary: ESM UTBYGGING AS (org. no. 990 635 625) is a private limited company (AS) based in Ålesund, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2006-12-27. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.120 (Utvikling og salg av byggeprosjekter); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 46 126. CEO: Sindre Moldskred; board chair: Sindre Moldskred; auditor: BDO AS.
